tasks.subject: Task 1: Schema — role, drop unique, Invitation model
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add the data model this feature depends on.

**Files:**
- Modify: `prisma/schema.prisma`
- Modify: `prisma/schema.production.prisma`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `User.merchantId` is no longer `@unique` — a Merchant can have many Users
- [ ] `User.role` exists as `String @default("OWNER")` — existing rows backfill to `"OWNER"` automatically
- [ ] `Merchant.user User?` becomes `Merchant.users User[]`
- [ ] New `Invitation` model exists with `merchantId` (relation, cascade delete), `email`, unique `tokenHash`, `invitedByUserId`, `expiresAt`, nullable `acceptedAt`, `createdAt`
- [ ] Both schema files stay in sync (only the `datasource` block differs)

**Verify:** `npx prisma db push && npx prisma generate` → "Your database is now in sync with your Prisma schema", no errors

**Steps:** See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-multi-user-teams.md Task 1 for full prisma model diffs.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["prisma/schema.prisma", "prisma/schema.production.prisma"], "verifyCommand": "npx prisma db push && npx prisma generate", "acceptanceCriteria": ["User.merchantId no longer @unique", "User.role defaults to OWNER", "Merchant.users is User[]", "Invitation model exists with hashed tokenHash", "both schema files in sync"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Session layer — role support + requireOwnerApi()
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make `role` a first-class part of the session, and add an Owner-only guard for the routes that need it.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/lib/auth/session.ts`
- Modify: `src/lib/auth/session.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/lib/auth/requireSession.ts`
- Modify: `src/lib/auth/requireSession.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `SessionUser` includes `role: "OWNER" | "MEMBER"`, sourced the same way `merchantId` already is
- [ ] `requireOwnerApi()` returns the session when `role === "OWNER"`, throws `HttpError(403, ...)` otherwise
- [ ] `requireOwnerApi()` throws `HttpError(401, ...)` when unauthenticated
- [ ] All existing session.test.ts/requireSession.test.ts cases still pass with the fixture updated to include `role`

**Verify:** `npm test -- src/lib/auth/session.test.ts src/lib/auth/requireSession.test.ts` → all pass

**Steps:** See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-multi-user-teams.md Task 2 for full code.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/auth/session.ts", "src/lib/auth/session.test.ts", "src/lib/auth/requireSession.ts", "src/lib/auth/requireSession.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- src/lib/auth/session.test.ts src/lib/auth/requireSession.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["SessionUser has role field", "requireOwnerApi returns session for OWNER", "requireOwnerApi throws 403 for MEMBER", "requireOwnerApi throws 401 unauthenticated"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Invitation business logic library
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Token creation/validation/listing logic for invitations, independent of any route — mirrors resetToken.ts's shape and test style.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/team/invitation.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/team/invitation.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `createInvitation()` generates a 64-hex-char raw token, stores only its SHA-256 hash, sets a 7-day expiry, and deletes any existing pending invitation for the same (merchantId, email) pair first
- [ ] `findValidInvitation()` returns null for unknown/already-accepted/expired tokens
- [ ] `markInvitationAccepted()` sets acceptedAt to now
- [ ] `revokeInvitation()` deletes a pending invitation scoped by merchantId, throws HttpError(404,...) otherwise
- [ ] `listTeam()` returns active members and pending invitations (with `expired` flag) for a merchant
- [ ] All functions typed against `Prisma.TransactionClient` (not `PrismaClient`) so they're callable both standalone and inside a `prisma.$transaction()` callback

**Verify:** `npm test -- src/lib/team/invitation.test.ts` → all pass (12 tests)

**Steps:** See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-multi-user-teams.md Task 3 for full code.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/team/invitation.ts", "src/lib/team/invitation.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- src/lib/team/invitation.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["createInvitation returns 64-hex token and stores only hash", "findValidInvitation returns null for expired/accepted/unknown", "revokeInvitation throws 404 when nothing matched", "listTeam flags expired pending invites"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Team invite management API (Owner-only) + invite email
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Let the Owner invite, list, resend, and revoke teammates.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/email/sendInviteEmail.ts` + test
- Create: `src/app/api/team/route.ts` + test
- Create: `src/app/api/team/invite/route.ts` + test
- Create: `src/app/api/team/invitations/[id]/route.ts` + test
- Create: `src/app/api/team/invitations/[id]/resend/route.ts` + test

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `GET /api/team` returns members + pending invitations; any authenticated user can call it
- [ ] `POST /api/team/invite` (Owner-only) creates an invitation and sends an email; 400 invalid email, 409 email already has an account, 403 non-owner
- [ ] `DELETE /api/team/invitations/[id]` (Owner-only) revokes; 404 if not caller's merchant
- [ ] `POST /api/team/invitations/[id]/resend` (Owner-only) reissues with a fresh token; old token stops working
- [ ] `sendInviteEmail()` silently no-ops when RESEND_API_KEY unset

**Verify:** `npm test -- src/lib/email/sendInviteEmail.test.ts "src/app/api/team"` → all pass

**Steps:** See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-multi-user-teams.md Task 4 for full code.

tasks.subject: Task 5: Public invite accept flow
tasks.description:

- Create: `src/app/api/invite/[token]/accept/route.ts` + test
- Create: `src/app/invite/[token]/page.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `GET /api/invite/[token]` returns `{ merchantName, email }` for valid token, 404 invalid/expired/accepted
- [ ] `POST /api/invite/[token]/accept` creates User (role: MEMBER, invitation's merchantId), marks invitation accepted, creates session, sets cookie; 404 invalid, 400 short password, 409 email claimed since invite sent
- [ ] `/invite/[token]` renders loading → not-found → ready → submitting → done state machine like `/survey/[token]`, redirects to `/dashboard` on success

**Verify:** `npm test -- "src/app/api/invite"` → all pass; manual browser check

**Steps:** See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-multi-user-teams.md Task 5 for full code.

tasks.subject: Task 6: Remove and leave
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Let the Owner remove a Member, and let a Member leave voluntarily — either way, that user's access is revoked immediately.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/app/api/team/[userId]/route.ts` + test
- Create: `src/app/api/team/leave/route.ts` + test

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `DELETE /api/team/[userId]` (Owner-only): destroys target's sessions then removes them; 404 if not in caller's merchant; 400 if target is the Owner (including self-target)
- [ ] `POST /api/team/leave`: any Member removes themselves, destroys own sessions; 400 if called by Owner
- [ ] Leave clears the session cookie on the response

**Verify:** `npm test -- "src/app/api/team/[userId]" src/app/api/team/leave` → all pass

**Steps:** See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-08-multi-user-teams.md Task 6 for full code.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/app/api/team/[userId]/route.ts", "src/app/api/team/leave/route.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npm test -- \"src/app/api/team/[userId]\" src/app/api/team/leave", "acceptanceCriteria": ["remove destroys sessions before deleting user", "remove rejects owner-targets-self with 400", "leave rejects owner with 400", "leave clears session cookie"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
